response.sql:
WITH scopes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT acctscope
  FROM users
),
matched_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT u.acctscope, o.recordvault
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault
  JOIN users AS u ON u.userstamp = o.userlink
),
counts AS (
  SELECT s.acctscope, COUNT(m.recordvault) AS order_count
  FROM scopes AS s
  LEFT JOIN matched_orders AS m ON m.acctscope IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.acctscope
  GROUP BY s.acctscope
)
SELECT acctscope,
       order_count,
       order_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(order_count) OVER (), 0) AS share_of_total,
       order_count::numeric / NULLIF(AVG(order_count) OVER (), 0) AS divided_by_average
FROM counts
ORDER BY acctscope;

assumptions.assumption: Counts distinct orders even if an order has multiple matching risk/margin records; includes every account scope present in users, including scopes with zero matches. The average and total use those scopes.

alternatives.interpretation: If each matching risk/margin record is the counting unit, rather than each distinct order, count matching rows per scope.
alternatives.sql:
WITH scopes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT acctscope FROM users
),
counts AS (
  SELECT s.acctscope, COUNT(r.riskandmarginpivot) AS match_count
  FROM scopes AS s
  LEFT JOIN users AS u ON u.acctscope IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.acctscope
  LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  LEFT JOIN riskandmargin AS r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY s.acctscope
)
SELECT acctscope,
       match_count,
       match_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(match_count) OVER (), 0) AS share_of_total,
       match_count::numeric / NULLIF(AVG(match_count) OVER (), 0) AS divided_by_average
FROM counts
ORDER BY acctscope;
